zh.title: 同为半分，覆盖为何不同：科学工作流评分的解释边界
zh.summary: 四个查询上的两组构造输出都得到 0.5 分，却分别覆盖全部和一半查询。有限公式实验说明，解读科学工作流评测需要保留覆盖、条件通过率、任务权重与指标有效性的分账。

en.title: The Same Half-Score Can Hide Different Coverage in Scientific Workflows
en.summary: Constructed outputs score 0.5 while covering all or half of four queries. A bounded equation experiment shows why coverage, conditional target pass, task weights and metric validity must remain visible alongside a scientific-workflow score.
